## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria of the task are met
- [ ] Tests and lint pass (`uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Data validates (`uv run sondaje validate`), if data or schema changed
- [ ] Docs are updated if behaviour, schema, or methodology changed
- [ ] The task file's Log and Outcome are filled in, and its status is `done`
- [ ] Every commit message starts with the task ID
